# GitHub Copilot instructions

This repository is the source of the RNZ Fabric app templates, not an app. Read `AGENTS.md` at the repo root first and follow it.

- To build an app: don't build here. Run `scripts/new-app.ps1`, then work in the new app's folder.
- To maintain the template: only when the person asks explicitly. Never rename or move files, keep the RICOH logo as the lock-up only, and run the checks listed in `AGENTS.md` before committing.
